data_policy: REAL API only when configured; otherwise clearly identified demo/local mode
public_install_policy: Do not require users to disable device security. Direct APK sideload is a test artifact, not the public install route.
store_gate: Store publication still requires the publisher account, signing/review requirements and submission on the chosen authorized store.
pwa_gate: Deploy the web directory over HTTPS for installable browser/PWA distribution.
